title: Burchett's 'five to seven undersea bases' claim traced to the email

tellings.quote: what I think happened is someone who'd seen that email is the one who talked to Burchett.

plain: A US congressman, Tim Burchett, has said there may be five to seven bases under the sea linked to unexplained craft. Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, says on a podcast that he thinks the claim came from an email written by a naval intelligence commander. In his view, someone who had seen that email is the one who talked to Burchett, which would explain where the number came from.
